review_hvsr_config: review the HVSR config file for model hyperparameters and dataset pipeline settings
summarize_hvsr_config: summarize the HVSR training configuration including optimizer, learning rate schedule, and data loaders
refactor_hvsr_train_pipeline: refactor the HVSR train_pipeline to add or remove augmentation steps like Flip or ColorJitter
